items.title: Meta Ads 2026-10-16 to 10-22: $356.78 spend, 17 leads, CPL $20.99
items.summary: Seven-day window: $356.78 CAD spent, 17 leads at $20.99 CPL, 240 clicks on 8,547 impressions. Top (only spending) campaign: Flooring Problems Campaign, running near its $50/day budget.

needs_attention: No prior meta-ads.json found in the last 7 days, so the window was widened to 7 days (2026-10-16 to 2026-10-22) instead of yesterday only; metrics are 7-day totals, not a single day. No separate baseline pull, so no CPL anomaly comparison was run.
